prompts.title: Professional Email Writer for Customer Service
prompts.prompt_text:
You are a professional email writer specializing in customer service. Write a polite, empathetic, and solution-oriented email response to a customer complaint about [DESCRIBE ISSUE]. The email should:

1. Acknowledge the customer's frustration
2. Apologize sincerely for the inconvenience
3. Explain what happened (if known)
4. Provide a clear solution or next steps
5. Offer compensation or goodwill gesture if appropriate
6. End with reassurance and contact information

Tone: Professional, empathetic, solution-focused
Length: 150-250 words
Format: Standard business email
prompts.description: This prompt helps customer service teams craft professional, empathetic email responses to customer complaints. It ensures all key elements of a good service recovery email are included while maintaining a consistent professional tone.

prompts.title: Stunning Product Photography in Studio Setting
prompts.prompt_text: Professional product photography, [PRODUCT NAME] centered on clean white background, studio lighting setup with soft box lights from 45-degree angles, subtle shadows for depth, high-end commercial photography style, sharp focus on product details, 8k resolution, photorealistic, clean composition, --ar 1:1 --style raw --v 6
prompts.description: Creates professional studio-quality product photos perfect for e-commerce, catalogs, or marketing materials. Adjust the product name and you can generate consistent, high-quality product images with proper lighting and composition.

prompts.title: Python Function Documentation Generator
prompts.prompt_text:
Generate comprehensive documentation for the following Python function. Include:

1. A clear description of what the function does
2. Parameter descriptions with types
3. Return value description with type
4. Example usage with sample input/output
5. Any exceptions that might be raised
6. Time/space complexity if relevant

Format the documentation in Google-style docstring format.

Function to document:
[PASTE YOUR FUNCTION HERE]
prompts.description: Automatically generates professional, comprehensive documentation for Python functions in Google-style docstring format. Perfect for maintaining code documentation standards across your project.

prompts.title: Social Media Content Calendar Planner
prompts.prompt_text:
Create a 30-day social media content calendar for [BRAND/BUSINESS NAME] with the following specifications:

Business Type: [e.g., Coffee Shop, Tech Startup, Fashion Brand]
Target Audience: [describe your audience]
Platforms: [Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, etc.]
Posting Frequency: [e.g., 5 posts per week]
Content Pillars: [e.g., Educational, Promotional, Entertainment, User-Generated]

For each post, provide:
- Date and time
- Platform
- Content type (image, video, carousel, story)
- Caption with hashtags
- Content pillar category
- Call-to-action

Format as a table with columns: Date, Platform, Type, Caption, CTA, Pillar
prompts.description: Generates a complete month-long social media content calendar tailored to your brand. Includes strategic post types, captions, hashtags, and CTAs organized by content pillars for balanced engagement.

prompts.title: Cinematic Aerial Drone Shot of Coastal Landscape
prompts.prompt_text: Cinematic aerial drone footage, sweeping over dramatic coastal cliffs at golden hour, waves crashing against rocks below, warm sunset light casting long shadows, camera movement: slow forward dolly with gentle descent, professional color grading with teal and orange tones, 4k resolution, stabilized footage, shallow depth of field on distant horizon, --motion 4 --camera slow-pan --duration 10s
prompts.description: Creates stunning cinematic drone footage perfect for video projects, travel content, or establishing shots. The prompt specifies camera movement, lighting, and color grading for professional results.
